text: The trust workflow chooses the acceptance criterion's declaratively mapped real CSV path, not EyeLink ASC. The previous DAG incorrectly blocked this narrow trust slice on all of ms-v0.5 through aoi-set/io-csv/io-export/timeline and on hosted CI. Those broad edges were replaced by trust-sync-golden, trust-csv-golden, trust-aoi-golden, and trust-tidy-golden. The golden composition waits on those four; the trust epic still waits independently on hosted CI, so CI certifies the workflow after implementation instead of preventing it. Full generic AOI, ASC, Arrow, and broad v0.5 work remain in their original beads.
